relationships.subject: bergenin
relationships.evidence_quote: Bergenin treatment leads to a significant and dose-dependent reduction in evoked and spontaneous ongoing pain without causing central side effects in neuropathic rats.

relationships.subject: chemotherapy
relationships.evidence_quote: Chemotherapy administration leads to a significant activation of TRP channels, concurrent with microglial activation, disruption of spinal cord tight junction proteins

relationships.subject: bergenin
relationships.evidence_quote: Notably, bergenin treatment effectively reversed all of these alterations, with the exception of TRPM8, in both the DRG and spinal cord of neuropathic rats.

key_findings: Bergenin dose-dependently reduces evoked and spontaneous pain in chemotherapy-induced neuropathic rats without altering baseline thresholds.
Bergenin reverses chemotherapy-induced TRPV1, TRPA1 and NR2B activation, microglial activation and tight junction disruption, but not TRPM8.
